relationship_inspection.contact: No visible gap at driver-to-pivot contact. A visible screw slot cannot be confirmed because the shaft covers the center; the intended mechanical engagement is only partly demonstrated.
relationship_inspection.edges: All required text has canvas margin. Mirror rim, U support, stem, and base are contained. Driver handle crosses and is cut off at the right canvas border. The guarantee line ends very close to the mirror left rim but appears separate.
relationship_inspection.action: Deadline and full URL are large, adjacent blue lines. Full URL is unbroken. Their left edge aligns with the main copy, with mirror nearby on the right.
relationship_inspection.whole_copy_relationship: The large horizontal title and subtitle establish the common left and right limits of the editorial area. Schedule is grouped in blue bold text; five clauses are normal black lines in a broad central region; application blue block sits beside the mirror and above fee/contact. The longest clause remains full and readable, but almost touches the mirror. The very large heavy title occupies about one quarter of the square and departs from the assigned moderate title weight. Fee appears below application rather than before it as in the source list.
relationship_inspection.object_structure: A recognisable oval tabletop mirror with curved U frame and side pivot, stem, and round base. Driver is inserted from the right. Contours are mostly consistent; base has a slight gray shadow. No human hand or unrelated tools are added.
relationship_inspection.finish: No additional slogan, fake microtext, logo, or watermark is visible. Title spacing and operational clauses are clean enough to read. The cropped tool and hidden screw-slot detail remain visible limitations; no overall quality score or certification is assigned.

retained_defects_uncertainties: Screwdriver handle is cropped at the right canvas edge, contrary to the assigned safe-edge condition.
Visible screw-slot engagement is not verifiable; shaft contact is visible but the slot is obscured.
Title and subtitle are very heavy; assigned medium-weight title was not realised.
Time-range dash appears short and exact en-dash punctuation is not certified.
The longest guarantee clause is close to the mirror rim, although no overlap is visible at native or 720.
All small clauses are not independently certified at 320 px.
The native tool has no explicit size argument; 1254 × 1254 is the actual return and maximum possible resolution is not verified.
